description: This file defines a MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions within a request processing pipeline in an ASP.NET Core application. It wraps the request handling in a transaction, ensuring commit or rollback based on success or exception.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior`2
classes.description: A pipeline behavior class that manages database transactions for requests processed via MediatR.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Wraps the request handling in a transaction, committing if successful, rolling back on exception.
